public_body: Fall River Redevelopment Authority Preliminary Screening Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a minutes request sent only to the City Clerk, who is not subject to the OML, did not trigger the Committee's 10-day response duty.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to respond within 10 days to a request to review minutes, sent to the City Clerk as both an Open Meeting Law and Public Records Law request.
allegations.key_passage: However, because the request for minutes was sent to the City Clerk without any request that it be forwarded to the Committee, and the City Clerk is not subject to the Open Meeting Law, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
